history.summary: A spacious 1,647sqft freehold 4BR at Rezi 35, D14, asking $1,700 psf — a ~5% premium to the $1,626 URA median — within 610m of Paya Lebar interchange. Tenure, size and location are good, but the resale rate is negative (-0.31%/yr) on an extremely thin 10-txn series, so there is no reliable price-trend signal to underwrite a $2.8M entry.
history.rating_rationale: Genuine merits — freehold, a generous 1,647sqft 4BR layout, and 610m to the Paya Lebar EW/CC interchange in an airbase-relocation district. But the only resale data is -0.31%/yr on just 10 transactions (too thin to trust either way), the asking is ~5% above median, and $2.8M sits above the deepest-liquidity band for a 4BR. Reasonable freehold family asset without demonstrated momentum — Neutral.
red_flags: Resale series only 10 txn (negative rate, but unreliable)
catalysts: D14 Paya Lebar Central / airbase-relocation upside

history.summary: Young (2020) freehold boutique in city-fringe D14, 7-min walk to Paya Lebar interchange, asking ~6% below the project's own recent average PSF. The best value/location combination of the five.
history.rating_rationale: Listing is $1,592 psf vs the project's last-12-month average of ~$1,698 psf (range $1,659-$1,736) — a genuine ~6% discount confirmed against actual same-project comps, not just the algo's age-adjusted -21%. Freehold, completed 2020 (still young), built by TEE Land + KSH (credible developers). Location is strong: 7-min walk to Paya Lebar EW/Circle interchange, RCR (forward ~+3.5%). At 1,162 sqft this is a large 3BR (project typical 3BR ~797 sqft), so it is a premium layout; the $1.85M absolute quantum is high for D14, which caps the rental-yield case (~3.8% project yield). I do not lean on the trailing 3.7% appreciation (regional baseline, only 10 txns, ~0 forward power) — the verdict rests on verified relative value, freehold tenure and the interchange catalyst.
